messages:
maria: Heads-up — running a quick forecast. Weekend promo might spike embeddings + rerank. Can infra afford a mixed batch + realtime setup? Need GPU-hours estimate by Friday. @lee @sam
lee: rough numbers from eyeballing traffic: promo could double embed QPS and push rerank up ~3x during peak minutes. We need the realtime vs batch split to model properly.
sam: we ran a similar sim last month — we saw ~30% realtime / 70% batch for rerank, but tail latency was the killer for realtime.
anya: constraint: us-west1 has scheduled maintenance that weekend (limited A10 capacity). If routing pushes a lot to eu-west1 cost goes up.
maria: ok. Can someone run a short sim with these params: baseline embeds 1200/min, rerank 200/min, promo multiplies traffic x2 for a 4-hour peak window, assume realtime fraction 40% for rerank. Include spillover to eu-west1 if us-west saturates.
lee: starting a run now with cluster-sim. command used:
```
./tools/cluster-sim --model embed-v2 --rerank-mode mixed --qps 2400 --rerank 400 --realtime-share 0.4 --peak-hours 4 --regions us-west1,eu-west1
```
lee: initial quick-pass numbers: if everything stays in us-west, we need an extra ~12 A100 GPU equivalents per peak hour (so ~48 GPU-hours over 4 hours). If we allow eu-west spill, raw GPU-hours go up ~18% due to smaller instance sizes and lower packing efficiency, but latency SLOs are preserved.
devops-bot: Simulation started (run id: sim-1796005012). ETA ~8m.
lee: found an optimization: larger batch sizes for the batch pool recover ~20% of GPU-hours for embeddings. So batching knobs matter a lot here.
sam: note on model stack: switching rerank to q4 quant reduces compute ~22% but increases rerank quality delta ~0.8% — need product sign-off.
anya: ops constraint again: we cannot provision additional dedicated GPUs in us-west during the maintenance window. Options: route to eu-west, increase batching, or pre-warm a short burst pool in advance.
tarek: cost thought: pre-warming a burst pool of 12 GPUs for 6 hours looks cheaper than multiple small autoscale events (less orchestration churn). I'll attach a quick cost calc.
julio: pinging finance — what's acceptable cost uplift for the weekend promo? :money_with_wings:
maria: can we get final numbers by EOD? We need to pick routing policy and whether to enable batch fallback for rerank.
lee: will post full sim summary + CSV in #eng-infra after run completes. Interim recommendation: enable eu-west spill, bump batch-pool max-batch to 64, and pre-warm 8 GPUs for the 4-hour peak. Estimated extra GPU-hours ~96 total across regions, cost +14%.
sam: +1 to pre-warm. It avoids cold-starts and prevents SLO violations at the tail.
anya: I'll change routing policy to prefer us-west but fail over to eu-west when queue depth > 500 or CPU queued-ms > 200ms.
devops-bot: Simulation completed. sim-1796005012 -> summary.csv uploaded: https://internal.redwood/sim-results/sim-1796005012.csv
maria: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate a short sync if we need clarification. :thumbsup:
lee: noted — adding runbook steps for pre-warm + failover in the ops doc.
julio: finance OKayed up to +20% cost bump for the promo window.
maria: great. Final plan for deployment: pre-warm 8 GPUs in us-west for 1 hour before promo, enable spillover to eu-west, increase batch size for embed pool to 64, and enable batch fallback for low-priority rerank requests. I'll open a change request.
sam: change request created: CR-2026-042. Link: https://redwood/cr/CR-2026-042
anya: ack, I'll be on-call that weekend and watching routing metrics.
